A '''Purple Fur Wampa Suit''' was a [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]] [[Clothing/Legends|costume]] for a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] that was made from [[Hair dye/Legends|dyed]] [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. The [[Suit/Legends|suit]] was retailed for 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CWA" />
